texts.zh:
[from.GetName]的永夜半球形成了一种独特的演化环境，让少数有机体能够生存在这颗严酷的行星上。

得益于独特的遗传特性，这里的生物群全都是半透明的，它们没有任何视觉，赖以非常复杂的回声定位生存。这种独特的适应性让我们的[controller.GetResearcherPlural_lower]们颇感兴趣。
texts.en:
The permanently dark side of [from.GetName] has fostered a unique evolutionary environment for the few organisms able to survive this harsh world.

Thanks to a unique chromosomal variation, the fauna here are entirely translucent, possess no vision, and deploy sophisticated forms of echolocation to survive. These remarkable adaptations are of great interest to our [controller.GetResearcherPlural_lower].

summary.text:
# 黑夜生灵 / Life in Darkness

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/103_anomaly_categories_extreme_frontiers.txt:340; events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:915 (extreme_frontiers.240)

## 如何开始 How it starts

无矿藏、不是地形改造候选的荒芜或寒冷荒芜星球可能生成（2级，权重3；需要 has_shroud_dlc）。

Can spawn on a barren or cold barren planet with no deposit that is not a terraforming candidate (level 2, weight 3; needs has_shroud_dlc).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.240“半透明演化”：三选一的选项由帝国类型决定——非杀戮帝国：每月社会研究加成与 d_society_5 矿藏；吞噬蜂群：每月食物加成与 d_food_5 矿藏；其他杀戮帝国：每月团结加成。

Single result extreme_frontiers.240 "Translucent Evolution": which option appears depends on the empire — non-homicidal: monthly society research and a d_society_5 deposit; Devouring Swarm: monthly food and a d_food_5 deposit; other homicidal empires: monthly unity.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果；选项按杀戮状态与公民决定，互相排斥。

Single outcome; the options are mutually exclusive by homicidal status and civic.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

240 的描述与选项按杀戮帝国状态和“吞噬蜂群”公民变化。

240's description and options vary with homicidal status and the Devouring Swarm civic.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义与结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。生成需要 has_shroud_dlc；本机 dlc 目录中未见对应 DLC，能否生成取决于主机的 DLC。

Checked the anomaly definition and the result event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed. Spawning needs has_shroud_dlc; no matching DLC folder exists in the local dlc directory, so spawning depends on the host's DLC.
